definitions.gloss: leader; guide; one who leads the way
definitions.explanation: A person who goes ahead and leads others, either literally (guiding a group) or figuratively (pioneering a field or movement).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先導者|せんどうしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is a pioneer in this field.

examples.japanese: {先導者|せんどうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please march following the guide's instructions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}{革新|かくしん}→技術革新：12892_gijutsukakushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先導者|せんどうしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: As a trailblazer in technological innovation, that company influenced the world.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{先導|せんどう}→先導：22653_sendou⟧ (guidance; leading the way) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Used for both literal guides (parade leaders, tour guides) and figurative pioneers (industry leaders, thought leaders).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先導者|せんどうしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: to be active as a leader
- {先導者|せんどうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす→役割を果たす：19503_yakuwariwohatasu⟧: to fulfill the role of a guide
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先導者|せんどうしゃ}: industry leader

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧: leader — more casual, widely used in everyday contexts
- ⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧: leader; instructor — emphasizes teaching and directing, often for political or organizational leaders
- ⟦{先駆者|せんくしゃ}→先駆者：27682_senkusha⟧: pioneer; forerunner — emphasizes being the first to do something, stronger sense of breaking new ground
- ⟦{案内人|あんないにん}→案内人：25113_annainin⟧: guide — specifically a person who shows the way, more practical than figurative
